title: Four-map formula for the K-flat comparison hom
statement: For a commutative ring sheaf R on a site, take cochain complexes E,K,M,F,N, K-flat E,K,F, and quasi-isomorphisms r:E to M, q:K to M, s:F to N. The hom of tensorResolutionComparison in degree i is the composite inverse H(id_E tensor s), H(r tensor id_F), inverse H(q tensor id_F), H(id_K tensor s), with the canonical associativity of composition. Definitions: [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology].

source.place: Tag 06YT, comparison through a common K-flat resolution; Tag 08DX(2), affine derived tensor computation.

proof.text: Expand the explicit definition of tensorResolutionComparison and project its hom. The composite is definitionally the stated four-map expression. The two inverse maps exist by K-flat tensor invariance.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorResolutionComparison_hom
    (E K M F N : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (r : E ⟶ M) (q : K ⟶ M) (s : F ⟶ N)
    (hE : E.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hK : K.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hF : F.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (hr : QuasiIso r) (hq : QuasiIso q) (hs : QuasiIso s) (i : ℤ) :
    (tensorResolutionComparison R E K M F N r q s hE hK hF hr hq hs i).hom =
      (let a := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 E) s (curriedTensor C) (.up ℤ)
       let b := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap r (𝟙 F) (curriedTensor C) (.up ℤ)
       let c := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap q (𝟙 F) (curriedTensor C) (.up ℤ)
       let d := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 K) s (curriedTensor C) (.up ℤ)
       letI : QuasiIso a := tensorResolution_quasiIso_tensor_left s hs hE
       letI : QuasiIso c := tensorResolution_quasiIso_tensor_right q hq hF
       inv (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap a i) ≫
         HomologicalComplex.homologyMap b i ≫
           inv (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c i) ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d i)
